'''Darth Love Obeisance v 3.0''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Darth Love]]
* '''Published:''' 20 February 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]] (inferred from the title)

== Introduction ==

Dark Deal draining and beat downs!

The deck page itself was not captured by the Wayback Machine, so only the listing-page entry (title, author, date and blurb) survives; the card list is lost.


== Notes ==

* Listing-only entry: the GPN listing page 10 records this deck, but the deck page itself was never captured by the Wayback Machine (checked 11 October 2026), so the card list is lost. The side is inferred from the published title.
